result.instructions: Qapsule is a live chart document whose numbers come only from a deterministic engine; you speak as `claude` and read with the data rights of the person you work for. Start with `whats_new` (what moved since your last look, the person's holdings and watches first); use `find` or `instrument` to locate capsules and `explain` to open one to its story, evidence and track record. Refer to things by meaning (e.g. capsule {"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","latest":true}) and cite the ids the answers give. Never compute, round or reformat numbers: quote them as printed, and where evidence says `requires`, say which data license it needs instead of guessing. `comment` is checked by the engine and returns machine-readable reasons to fix; `propose` only creates a proposal a person must accept — you cannot accept or reject anything. Watch matches arrive as notifications (`notifications` tool); everything you write is an observation, never investment advice.

tools.description: What moved since your last look: capsules born, changed or closed, the person's holdings and watches first, plus watch matches. First call: the latest moves. Example: {} or {"since_t":1760000000000}.

feed.description: Only the person's feed (watch list, sensitivity; holdings and watches always).

since_t.description: Look back to this time (epoch ms) instead of your last look.

tools.name: whats_new

tools.description: Find capsules (stories) by instrument, meaning, direction, stage, open/closed or time; most important first, paged. Example: {"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","open":true}.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

born_since_t.description: Born at or after this time (epoch ms).

since_t.description: Moved at or after this time (epoch ms).

tools.name: find

tools.description: Open one capsule: sentence, story transitions, evidence per fact (values, or the license it requires), track record, comments. Example: {"capsule":{"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","latest":true}}.

CapsuleRef.description: (R4) A capsule id (or its finding's id) or a [`CapsuleSel`].

CapsuleSel.description:
(R4) Selects a capsule with a story, e.g.
`{"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","open":true}` ("THYAO's open breakout
capsule"). Order: the latest transition's bar, then the birth bar, then document
order; so `latest` is the one that moved last.

first.description: Pick the first match (the one that moved earliest).

latest.description: Pick the last match (the one that moved last).

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

capsule.description:
Capsule id, finding id, or a selector such as
`{"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","latest":true}`.

detail.description: With `layered`: include story, evidence and comments.

tools.name: explain

tools.description: An instrument's stories (born, closed, outcome, in your feed or why not) and the session clock; without `symbol`, the instruments. Example: {"symbol":"THYAO","last":20}.

last.description: Only stories alive in the last this many bars.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol; absent: list the instruments.

tools.name: instrument

tools.description: The ledger: closed and realized counts per key (kind/direction/detector) or per kind. Example: {"meaning":"breakout","direction":"up"}.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

by_kind.description: Sum per meaning kind instead of per key.

tools.name: track_record

tools.description: Leave, remove or list watches for the person you work for; matches arrive as notifications. Example: {"text":"tell me if THYAO weakens","match":{"instrument":"THYAO","negative":true}}; {"action":"remove","intent":"watch-7-0"}.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

WatchMatch.description: (R5B, §25.5) What story transitions a watch matches. Every given field must hold.

holdings.description: Only instruments the person holds (non-zero position in their audience).

match.description: `add`: what story transitions match (every given field must hold).

tools.name: watch

tools.description: Attach a short comment to a capsule or instrument. The engine checks it: cited ids visible, every number from the cited evidence (as written there), no advice, no licensed number. A rejection lists reasons with hints. Example: {"capsule":"cap.THYAO.breakout.up.147","lang":"en","text":"THYAO closed above 312.5 [1].","cites":["cap.THYAO.breakout.up.147"]}.

CapsuleRef.description: (R4) A capsule id (or its finding's id) or a [`CapsuleSel`].

CapsuleSel.description:
(R4) Selects a capsule with a story, e.g.
`{"instrument":"THYAO","meaning":"breakout","open":true}` ("THYAO's open breakout
capsule"). Order: the latest transition's bar, then the birth bar, then document
order; so `latest` is the one that moved last.

first.description: Pick the first match (the one that moved earliest).

latest.description: Pick the last match (the one that moved last).

ExternalQuote.description: A quotation from an external (named) source, e.g. a news item or a report.

source.description: Who said it (e.g. `"matriks:news/123"`); must not be empty.

values.description: The numbers taken from the quote; each must appear in `quote`.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

capsule.description: The capsule it is about (id or selector); or give `instrument`.

cites.description: Ids it rests on (capsule, finding or fact; at least one).

external.description: Named external quotes with the numbers they give.

text.description: Plain text; `[n]` cites `cites[n-1]`. Only numbers the cited items give.

tools.name: comment

tools.description: Propose view/drawing ops (put_view, insert_layer, set_encoding, insert_panel, set_emphasis, set_view_range, add_study, show_finding…); returns the pending proposal and its preview. Only a person can accept it. Example: {"ops":[{"op":"set_view_range","view":"main","from_bar":100,"to_bar":150}]}.
tools.name: propose

tools.description: The closed vocabulary: meaning kinds, directions, stages, validity, time kinds, trust, evidence families. Example: {"term":"breakout"}.

term.description: Only entries whose name or text contains this (case-insensitive).

tools.name: glossary

tools.description: Draws a view of the document to a PNG image (headless) and returns it as image content with a one-line summary. Refused when the view shows data you are not entitled to.

look.description: Look (design record) to draw with, e.g. `r4` (the default).

proposal.description:
A pending proposal id: draws its preview (`docs/PROTOCOL.md` §25.6) — the
proposal's operations applied on a copy of the document; nothing is written.

tools.name: render

tools.description: Takes your pending qp/0 notifications (subscription `notify` messages, oldest first; each is returned once). Same as reading the qapsule://notifications resource.
tools.name: notifications
